title: Night Cream for Dull Skin: How to Bring Back a Radiant Look
ex: Why skin looks dull and tired, which night cream ingredients help it look radiant again, and a simple four-step night routine.
rt: Night Cream for Dull Skin: A Simple Guide | Mirc Glow
rd: Night cream for dull skin: why skin looks tired and flat, which ingredients help it look radiant, a four-step night routine and habits that support a glow.
quick: Choose a night cream for dull skin that hydrates well and adds a radiance ingredient such as niacinamide, vitamin C or glutathione. Cleanse gently, exfoliate only once or twice a week, apply a pea-sized amount at night and wear sunscreen every morning. A more radiant look builds over 8–12 weeks.
